method: Directional capability comparison from the linked official product pages, not a hands-on vendor certification. Advertised means the cited product family explicitly describes the capability, subject to edition, region and plan. Integration / companion means a separate product, connector, or related module. Not established means the reviewed page does not establish the feature; it is not a claim of absence. Rupert Available means code exists, not independently verified live. This is a scoped set of relevant competitors, not an exhaustive inventory of the market. POS parity additions were reviewed against official vendor/manual/partner sources on 2026-10-15. Cell-specific sources and notes distinguish terminal time tracking from remote attendance, generic commission from the requested overlap formula, and offline checkout from offline inventory work. Unknown cells require vendor demonstration rather than implying absence.

competitors.name: Cin7

competitors.name: Katana

competitors.name: Fishbowl

competitors.name: Brightpearl
competitors.caveat: Retail automation, inventory planning, accounting and integrations.

competitors.name: Linnworks
competitors.caveat: Listings, channel integrations, routing and shipping; not a full HR/finance suite.

competitors.name: Lightspeed Retail
competitors.caveat: Retail POS, suppliers, analytics and eCom; product/region and plan matter.

competitors.name: Square for Retail
competitors.caveat: Retail workflows with separate Square Staff, Payroll, Loyalty and Marketing products.

competitors.name: Shopify POS
competitors.caveat: Commerce and POS, with app ecosystem extensions; POS Pro/plan restrictions apply.

competitors.name: KORONA POS
competitors.caveat: Retail POS with KORONA Studio; inventory and reporting vary by package. Tips depend on supported processor/terminal configuration. POS time tracking is documented; remote employee punches and the exact overlapping-shift commission rule are not established.

competitors.name: Cova POS
competitors.caveat: POS with Cova Pay and optional HR/payroll partners. Payment types, tipping, hardware and market availability depend on country/provider. KayaPush adds mobile attendance; the exact overlapping-shift commission rule is not established.

competitors.name: C-Trax Serv
competitors.caveat: Public site advertises retail POS, multi-location operations, roles, analytics, tipping and PAX hardware support. Some integration descriptions are placeholders; require a working demonstration and written provider confirmation. A specific hardware support cutoff was not independently verified.

sources.title: Official product and supported hardware overview

competitors.name: SwipeSimple
competitors.caveat: Payment acceptance, customer/item catalog, invoices and reporting; merchant provider, plan and hardware determine availability. Daily reports and batch reports use different cutoff rules. Rupert currently imports CSV sales; it does not operate a native SwipeSimple API adapter.

integration_candidates.name: Valmar Merchant Services

integration_candidates.caveat: The merchant account's actual gateway, API access, terminal compatibility and permitted products require confirmation. Rupert preparation does not enable processing.

integration_candidates.name: Easyteam
integration_candidates.scope: Official app/help material describes POS/mobile/web punches, reviewed timesheets, commission plans and payroll integrations.
integration_candidates.caveat: Companion candidate, not an ERP competitor. Generic commission plans and single-staff sales attribution do not establish the requested 1% for every worker clocked in during each sale. Confirm exact allocation before selection.
